### Part 4: Napa Valley vs. Gangnam-gu Venue Comparison Report

| Feature / Dimension | Napa Valley Venue Pool | Gangnam-gu, Seoul Venue Pool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Typical Capacity & Scale** | Most venues center on **200 to 450 guests** (with select estates like Charles Krug or Meritage scaling higher on open lawns). | Most venues center on **300 to 1,000 guests**, designed for high-density ceremonies and large sequential banquet dining. |
| **Primary Venue Types** | Historic wineries, private ranches, luxury spa/golf resorts, and garden estates. | Specialized multi-floor wedding halls, European castle/house venues (The Raum, Noble Valence), convention centers (Coex, Sono Felice), and 5-star international hotels (InterContinental, Imperial Palace). |
| **Atmosphere & Scenery** | Natural outdoor orientation: rolling vineyard hills, Mayacamas mountain vistas, ancient oak trees, outdoor fire pits, and wine caves. | Urban architectural grandeur: high ceilings (8–10m), multi-tiered crystal chandeliers, theatrical lighting, LED media walls, and floral aisle runways. |
| **Event Structure & Flow** | Often multi-day destination weekends (welcome reception, ceremony, dinner, late-night dancing, farewell brunch) with lodging on-site. | Structured single-day celebrations with defined time slots (typically 90 to 120 minutes per ceremony block), followed by immediate banquet or buffet dining. |
| **Weather Dependability** | High reliance on favorable fall weather for outdoor lawns and terraces (with indoor ballrooms or pavilions as contingency plans). | Fully climate-controlled indoor environments protected from seasonal weather fluctuations, with occasional rooftop or garden spaces (The Raum). |
| **Logistics & Accessibility** | Rural valley roads (Hwy 29, Silverado Trail); guests typically require chartered shuttles, private vehicles, or weekend hotel blocks. | Dense urban center with direct subway access (Subway Lines 2, 7, 9, Suin-Bundang Line), extensive basement parking structures, and city airport terminal integration. |
